addressed_findings.finding: Immediate assistant article A could be replaced by a later eligible article B during paint readiness.
addressed_findings.evidence: The helper now requires the paint_ready sample to match the immediate sample's article hash, selected article index, and transcript index before screenshot capture. Independent A-unpainted -> B-painted -> B-post_capture probe rejected with reviewer_chat_visible_answer_unverified and zero screenshot captures. The new regression test covers that path and asserts no capture.

addressed_findings.finding: Guard did not test immediate-to-readiness identity continuity.
addressed_findings.evidence: The new test `paint readiness cannot replace the terminal assistant selected by the immediate sample` exercises A-to-B and checks refusal, retained sanitized diagnostics, and no screenshot.

evidence: Same article A with an immediate opacity-zero proof followed by readable paint_ready A, screenshot capture, and matching post_capture A was accepted with one screenshot.
A-to-B during readiness now fails before screenshot capture. A-to-B after screenshot fails after one capture. Missing initial identity fails closed before screenshot capture.

Existing tests and source retain expected-term visibility, CSS paint, viewport and composer bounds, hit testing, active Chat pane, exact article/transcript identity, and post-capture pairing. Readiness uses the existing waitFor default of 10 seconds; no scroll_bottom path is called.
The outer terminal, demo, organization, resource, and foreground gates were not changed in this two-file patch.
verdict_a.native_outcome: PENDING. No native/hosted replay was performed. Source probes do not prove that the real panel screenshot contains readable answer text or that physical foreground visibility holds at capture time. document_visibility and hasFocus remain diagnostics because native side-panel visibility is separately evidenced.

evidence: The A-to-B regression guard is forcing for the reviewed defect: it reaches an eligible B from the wait predicate, then requires refusal before screenshot capture because B differs from the immediate A.

The existing negative guard rejects post-capture article/position/transcript changes, hidden paint, unreadable terms, inactive pane, missing indices, screenshot failure, and post-capture evaluation loss.
Current source privacy projection remains fixed-field only; no raw message text, message ID, or exception detail is added to evidence.
verdict_b.limits: Tests use controlled proof responses and screenshot doubles for orchestration. Native visual acceptance remains a separate required step.

checks.probe: Same article A opacity recovery; A-to-B readiness replacement; post-capture identity change; missing initial identity
checks.result: A recovery accepted with one screenshot; A-to-B refused with zero screenshots; post-capture change refused after one screenshot; missing identity refused with zero screenshots.
